# Dashes

> **这页管什么**：破折号不加空格；连接号一律不用。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/dashes> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Em dashes

Used to indicate a break in the flow of a sentence—or an interruption.

**Don't put a space before or after it.**

Entry methods: `&mdash;` in HTML; Option+Shift+hyphen on macOS; Alt+0151 on Windows numeric keypad; Compose + three hyphens on Linux.

## En dashes

**Don't use.** Use a hyphen or the word *to* instead.

## Em dash vs en dash vs hyphen

Don't substitute an en dash or hyphen where an em dash belongs. The guide notes spaced en dashes as an em-dash substitute are gaining traction mainly outside the US, so it sticks with em dashes.

## Dashes in item–description pairs

Using a dash to separate a term from its description is **common but nonstandard**.

- Use a colon or a period for single item-description pairs.
- For multiple items, use an HTML description list (`<dl>`).
- Preferred: "Example: This is an example" over "Example - This is an example".
- Preferred: "Appendix A: My first appendix".
